title: Refactor Coda Desktop From Measures To Properties With Measures
description: The coda desktop UI is still built around measures as top-level entities. The new coda system is built around properties with associated measures. Refactor the desktop UI to display all properties with their associated measures instead of showing measures as standalone entities.
summary: Refactored coda desktop from measure-centric to property-centric display. Added coda://properties and coda://property/{id} MCP resources to engine returning normalized property trees with canonical kinds and measure_kinds. Updated Property interface to include kind, measure_kinds, nested properties, items, and values. Replaced standalone Measures card with hierarchical Properties card showing recursive property trees with kind badges and measure_kind tags. Updated DashboardPage to show properties overview instead of measures. Refactored Platform display to show properties with measure-kind-keyed instructions (increase, decrease, etc.) with MCP tools/resources. Fixed collection-to-array canonicalization alias. Also fixed ReportPage to use validations/ValidationTree instead of broken rules-based display.
